picks.what: Bird’s-eye view, engraving in Braun and Hogenberg, Civitates Orbis Terrarum, vol. 5 (Bibliothèque nationale de France)
picks.why: bird’s-eye view of the walled town with its churches and streets drawn; flat single-sheet scan; title text trimmed

gaps: P0, P2, P3, P4, P5: nothing; P6: only views of hospital blocks and suburbs from the OUH tower, no historic center or skyline
notes: The plate’s title says the view was drawn in 1593, so it belongs to vol. 5 (first published 1598); the BnF copy is a 1640 printing and #1 is the same plate in a 1617 edition, photographed as an open book with the gutter through the view. #3 (Købke, a backyard in Odense with a church tower, dated only 1825–48) was left out as a single courtyard with an uncertain date.
